title: BoosterSimApp — Project Overview & PDR
scope_summary: Product requirements document for BoosterSimApp, a macOS menu-bar companion app that provides a floating side panel alongside the iOS Simulator with quick-access developer tools. Covers implemented Phase 1 and Phase 6 features (panel positioning, tab-based UI, environment overrides, certificate trust management), out-of-scope future phases, functional requirements (FR-01 through FR-16), non-functional requirements (NFR-01 through NFR-06), permission model, and success criteria.
